notes: Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/voidsworn_S8/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/voidsworn_S8.py; issue 738). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 27.0, the Dreadnought class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. No parts list here: the sheet places every part. game_code V1b_r_23 is the Dreadnought folder the game picks for voidsworn (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake stack (issue 756): stage 5 paints it with the Sunward kit's paint stack (tools/blender/kits/voidsworn/stack.py, through tools/blender/r209/bake_sheet.py; the direction is contrib/muse/design/paint_direction_2026_11/sunward.md, approved by Ryan Nov 14 2026); the colour zones are the sheet's. The sheet was accepted by Ryan on Nov 14 2026 (R254).
